vulnerability_analysis.vulnerability_type: CWE-285: Improper Authorization / Trusting Self-Declared Roles
vulnerability_analysis.description: An unauthorized caller executing `cbe bls-acquisition approve` can pass arbitrary strings for `--approver-id` and `--approver-role APPROVAL_ADMIN`. While the system enforces separation of duties (approver_id != created_by_operator_id) and validates that the role string equals APPROVAL_ADMIN, it does not verify that the process caller actually holds or has been issued that administrative identity.
vulnerability_analysis.impact: Allows an unauthorized user with local execution access to self-declare as APPROVAL_ADMIN and approve a prepared acquisition request without presenting independent credentials.

remediation_architecture.phase_1_immediate: Maintain TECHNICAL_NO_GO and refuse production activation.
remediation_architecture.phase_2_iam_integration: Bind operator approval to public-key signatures (e.g. GPG/SSH/Ed25519) from an approved admin keyring or integrate with enterprise IAM/OIDC identity provider.
